ro-write-outside.why: a review that changes the code it reviews is no longer a review
ro-write-outside.message: a read-only run may not write outside OUT and TMP

next.lead: write the report in OUT; to test patches make a copy in TMP and work there
next.host: write the report in OUT; to test patches make a copy in TMP and work there

ro-second-tree.rule: A read-only run makes no second tree of the clone inside the clone
ro-second-tree.why: a git write is judged where the shell is, and a clone or an init inside the clone changes it
ro-second-tree.message: a read-only run may not clone or init inside the clone

next.lead: clone into TMP with git -C TMP clone CLONE x, then work in TMP/x
next.host: clone into TMP with git -C TMP clone CLONE x, then work in TMP/x

ro-env-restricted.rule: A read-only run does not assign the variables that decide what runs
ro-env-restricted.why: PATH, HOME, TMPDIR and the git and loader variables decide which program a command is
ro-env-restricted.message: a read-only run may not assign this variable

next.lead: pass the path as an argument instead of assigning the variable
next.host: pass the path as an argument instead of assigning the variable

member-push.why: the lead's branches are the lead's; a member hands patches back

next.lead: return patches in OUT; the lead takes them in
next.host: return patches in OUT; the lead takes them in

member-lead-verb.rule: A member does not run the lead's verbs
member-lead-verb.why: the lead's verbs change the project's records, runs and branches
member-lead-verb.message: a member may not run this verb

next.lead: report what you needed in your report; the lead runs the verb
next.host: report what you needed in your report; the lead runs the verb

member-run-record.rule: A member does not write the lead's run records
member-run-record.why: the run directory is the member's to write, and the lead's registry is the lead's
member-run-record.message: a member may not write this run record

next.lead: write your outputs in OUT and report; the lead's registry records the run
next.host: write your outputs in OUT and report; the lead's registry records the run

seat-record-invalid.rule: The answers file of a seated project is readable and its marker valid (R54)
seat-record-invalid.why: the seat cannot be judged from records that cannot be read
seat-record-invalid.message: {verb} is refused: the answers of the project cannot be read, or hold an invalid marker

next.lead: stop and tell the owner: a lead cannot repair the seat records
next.host: stop and tell the owner: a lead cannot repair the seat records

seat-record-missing.rule: A seated project has its assignment file and its projection (R55)
seat-record-missing.why: a session the supervising layer did not assign has no seat
seat-record-missing.message: {verb} is refused: this session has no bound seat record for a seated project

next.lead: stop and tell the owner: this session was not assigned the seat
next.host: stop and tell the owner: this session was not assigned the seat

records-disagree.rule: The assignment file and the projection agree on the holder (R56)
records-disagree.why: a competing session with another unit's file is not the holder
records-disagree.message: {verb} is refused: the assignment of this session and the projection of the seat disagree

next.lead: stop: this session is not the holder; tell the owner
next.host: stop: this session is not the holder; tell the owner

previous-epoch.rule: The assignment file is not of an earlier epoch than the projection (R57)
previous-epoch.why: a stale lead is refused after the cutover
previous-epoch.message: {verb} is refused: this session holds the seat of an earlier epoch

next.lead: stop: the seat moved on; tell the owner
next.host: stop: the seat moved on; tell the owner

projection-stale.rule: The projection is as new as the assignment file (R58)
projection-stale.why: a write must not run on a projection that has not caught up
projection-stale.message: {verb} is refused: the projection of the seat is older than the assignment

next.lead: wait until the projection is current, then run the verb again; read-only verbs still run
next.host: wait until the projection is current, then run the verb again; read-only verbs still run

transfer-in-progress.rule: No lead verb changes the project while a transfer is open (R60)
transfer-in-progress.why: the handoff must see a project that does not move
transfer-in-progress.message: {verb} is refused: a lead transfer is open, so a lead verb that writes is refused

next.lead: finish the transfer with its own verbs, or wait for it to end
next.host: finish the transfer with its own verbs, or wait for it to end

readback-pending.rule: No lead verb changes the project while a read-back is pending (R61)
readback-pending.why: the incoming lead has not confirmed what it believes
readback-pending.message: {verb} is refused: a read-back of the incoming lead is pending, so a lead verb that writes is refused

next.lead: submit or wait for the read-back, then run the verb again
next.host: submit or wait for the read-back, then run the verb again

seat-vacant.rule: A vacant seat is held by nobody who may write (R62)
seat-vacant.why: a project with no lead is looked after only by a caretaker
seat-vacant.message: {verb} is refused: the seat of the project is vacant

next.lead: ask the owner to assign a lead or a caretaker
next.host: ask the owner to assign a lead or a caretaker

not-assigned.rule: A verb of class owner is not run by an assigned lead (R59)
not-assigned.why: the owner's verbs are the owner's, run outside the lead's session
not-assigned.message: {verb} is refused: this verb is the owner's and this session is not the owner

next.lead: ask the owner to run it as qargi host VERB, in the owner's own session
next.host: ask the owner to run it as qargi host VERB, in the owner's own session

caretaker-denied.rule: A caretaker runs no lead verb that writes (R63)
caretaker-denied.why: a caretaker keeps the project looked after; it does not lead
caretaker-denied.message: {verb} is refused: a caretaker may not run this verb

next.lead: run only qargi env check, doctor, packs check or marshal caretaker request, or ask the owner for a lead
next.host: run only qargi env check, doctor, packs check or marshal caretaker request, or ask the owner for a lead

gate-error.rule: A gate that cannot answer refuses (R67)
gate-error.message: {verb} is refused: the gate of the seat could not answer, so the verb was refused

next.lead: tell the owner: run the verb again, and if it is refused again the gate itself needs a look
next.host: tell the owner: run the verb again, and if it is refused again the gate itself needs a look

seated-project.rule: A marshal claim, take or release is not run on a seated project (R27)
seated-project.message: {verb} is refused: the project is seated, so claim, take and release are refused

next.lead: use the seat's own transfer verbs
next.host: use the seat's own transfer verbs

assignment-invalid.rule: An assignment is well formed and names nothing reserved or unsafe (R4, R5, R18, R19, R28, R89)
assignment-invalid.message: {verb} is refused: the assignment breaks the rules of its shape, names a reserved value or declares an unsafe path

next.lead: correct the assignment and submit it again
next.host: correct the assignment and submit it again

transfer-open.rule: A new assignment waits while a transfer is open (R43)
transfer-open.why: two transfers at once cannot both be fenced
transfer-open.message: {verb} is refused: a transfer is open, so a new assignment is refused

next.lead: finish or abort the open transfer first
next.host: finish or abort the open transfer first

abort-after-fence.rule: A transfer cannot be aborted once the old lead is fenced (R42)
abort-after-fence.message: {verb} is refused: the transfer is past the fence and cannot be aborted

next.lead: complete the transfer
next.host: complete the transfer

fence-required.rule: A transfer goes past the fence only with an accepted fence (R36)
fence-required.why: the old lead must be proven ended first
fence-required.message: {verb} is refused: the step needs an accepted fence and there is none

next.lead: record the fence, then take the step
next.host: record the fence, then take the step

fence-unproven.rule: A fence proves the end of this epoch (R20, R29)
fence-unproven.why: a fence that proves nothing lets two leads write
fence-unproven.message: {verb} is refused: the fence does not prove the end of this epoch

next.lead: give a fence the transition allows, with proof
next.host: give a fence the transition allows, with proof

readback-mismatch.rule: The read-back matches what the project says (R49)
readback-mismatch.why: the incoming lead must believe what is true
readback-mismatch.message: {verb} is refused: the read-back does not match

next.lead: read again from the stored records and submit the new read-back
next.host: read again from the stored records and submit the new read-back

readback-exhausted.rule: A transfer allows three failed read-backs (R39)
readback-exhausted.why: a lead that cannot read the project should not take it
readback-exhausted.message: {verb} is refused: a third read-back failed

next.lead: the owner decides: abort the transfer or assign again
next.host: the owner decides: abort the transfer or assign again

note-digest-mismatch.rule: The handoff note is the one recorded (R41, R47)
note-digest-mismatch.why: a changed note is another note
note-digest-mismatch.message: {verb} is refused: the digest of the note differs from the recorded one

next.lead: send the note that was recorded, or record the new one
next.host: send the note that was recorded, or record the new one

note-invalid.rule: The handoff note verifies and belongs to this transfer (R47)
note-invalid.why: a note of another transfer or version proves nothing
note-invalid.message: {verb} is refused: the note does not verify, or names another transfer or version

next.lead: write the note again for this transfer
next.host: write the note again for this transfer

seat-changed.rule: A seat write sees the seat it read (R12)
seat-changed.why: two writers must not overwrite each other
seat-changed.message: {verb} is refused: the seat changed while this write was made

next.lead: read the seat again and repeat the write
next.host: read the seat again and repeat the write

refs-backend-active.rule: The shared refs backend and a seat exclude each other (R74)
refs-backend-active.why: the two keep the marshal's records in different places
refs-backend-active.message: {verb} is refused: the shared refs backend is on

next.lead: run marshal disable first, or leave the project unseated
next.host: run marshal disable first, or leave the project unseated

approval-refused.rule: A verb given --approved on a seated project is refused unless qargi host runs it (R76)
approval-refused.why: an approval is the owner's, typed outside the lead's session
approval-refused.message: {verb} is refused: --approved is given on a seated project outside qargi host

next.lead: show the plan to the owner; the owner runs the apply as qargi host VERB
next.host: show the plan to the owner; the owner runs the apply as qargi host VERB

authority-store-unsafe.rule: The authority store and the roots are safe paths (R8, R88, R89)
authority-store-unsafe.why: a store a lead can edit is no authority
authority-store-unsafe.message: {verb} is refused: the authority store or a root is unsafe or unset

next.lead: tell the owner: it is the owner's to repair
next.host: tell the owner: it is the owner's to repair

content-too-large.rule: A record is within its limit (R18)
content-too-large.message: {verb} is refused: the record is larger than its limit

next.lead: write a shorter record
next.host: write a shorter record

content-invalid.rule: A record other than an assignment keeps to its shape (R18, R22, R32)
content-invalid.why: a record that does not parse proves nothing
content-invalid.message: {verb} is refused: the record breaks the shape of its kind

next.lead: correct the record and submit it again
next.host: correct the record and submit it again

symlink-refused.rule: No path of the seat's stores is a symbolic link (R88)
symlink-refused.why: a link can point a write elsewhere
symlink-refused.message: {verb} is refused: a path of the seat's stores is a symbolic link

next.lead: replace the link with the directory it stands for
next.host: replace the link with the directory it stands for

caretaker-not-vacant.rule: A caretaker order waits for a vacant seat (R75)
caretaker-not-vacant.message: {verb} is refused: a lead holds the seat, so a caretaker order is refused

next.lead: wait for the seat to be vacant
next.host: wait for the seat to be vacant

host-in-sandbox.rule: qargi host runs only outside every sandbox, with a passed proof (R33, R103)
host-in-sandbox.why: the owner's own session is what the approvals rest on
host-in-sandbox.message: {verb} is refused: qargi host was refused: the proof outside the sandbox failed

next.lead: run it in the owner's own session, not in the lead's
next.host: run it in the owner's own session, not in the lead's

member-sandbox-off.rule: A member is dispatched only into a sandbox (dispatch)
member-sandbox-off.why: a member without one could reach what the lead holds
member-sandbox-off.message: {verb} is refused: the sandbox of the member is off, so the dispatch is refused

next.lead: report it to the owner; do not work round it
next.host: report it to the owner; do not work round it
